sections.title: Getting AWS onto your resume honestly

blocks.title: Not from your PDFs
blocks.text: No guide of yours covers this, so this page was written for the site, as of October 2026. Tools and versions change quickly: check the official documentation before relying on details.

blocks: For a 3 to 4 year Java role, **having deployed something real** usually counts for more than a certificate. A certificate helps with resume filters, mainly at service companies and for career changes.

sections.title: Suggested order

blocks.title: From zero to credible
blocks.code:
flowchart LR
  A[Budget alarm, IAM, S3] --> B[Deploy a Spring Boot app on ECS Fargate]
  B --> C[Add RDS, Secrets Manager and CloudWatch]
  C --> D[CI/CD with GitHub Actions and OIDC]
  D --> E[Add SQS and one Lambda]
  E --> F[Terraform everything]
  F --> G[Optional: certification]
blocks.caption: Your day-by-day plan's CareerFlux deployment is the natural project for this.

rows: Best fit for a Java developer
Third-party sources report DVA-C03 replacing DVA-C02 around December 2026: confirm on the AWS site
blocks.caption: Check the current exam details on the official AWS Certification site before you book.

blocks: **Other clouds:** the concepts transfer to Azure and Google Cloud. Learn one properly, and check job descriptions: many enterprises and service companies ask for Azure.

rows: Tagging and Cost Explorer first; rightsizing, autoscaling, S3 lifecycle rules, Savings Plans, NAT traffic
Autoscaling, a CDN, caching, queues to absorb writes, database limits
Revoke, audit CloudTrail, rotate, and remove the cause
Pre-signed S3 URLs, so that files bypass your servers
Multi-AZ tasks and database, health checks, no state on instances

blocks.title: Key points
blocks.text:
- Deploy something real before you study for an exam.
- Learn one cloud well; concepts transfer.
- Always mention cost and failure modes.
- Only list on your resume what you have actually used.

items.question: How do clients upload a 2 GB file without loading your API?
items.answer: The API issues a time-limited pre-signed S3 URL, and the client uploads directly. S3 can then notify a queue for processing.

items.question: Certificate or project, if you only have time for one?
items.answer: The project: it gives you interview stories. Add the certificate if your target employers filter on it.
